body:
I assume the intent here is mentioning **the ability** of extensions to provide multiple options.

"May" -> _"has the possibility of"_
"Can" -> _"Is able to"_

Many contributors use "_may_", "_might_", "_can"_, "_could_", etc. interchangeably, but it would be nice if we catch it sooner than later, as well as provide this general guideline.
